recognize_zh: 周邊血液中央有一顆與紅血球等大、邊緣呈泡狀突起的淡染巨大血小板（或巨核細胞胞質碎片），左側有一小塊深紫色顆粒狀的巨核細胞碎片，背景紅血球大小形狀不一並有淚滴細胞，符合骨髓纖維化的周邊血液表現。
features: Giant, pale, finely granular platelet about the size of a red cell with bubbly, blebbed margins
Small dense, deeply granular megakaryocytic fragment at left
Anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells, elliptocytes and occasional stomatocyte-like forms
Platelets of variable size, including large hypogranular forms
No white cells or nucleated red cells in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with teardrop cells and elliptocytes. Platelets vary in size and include a giant, pale, finely granular platelet approximately the size of a red cell with blebbed margins, as well as a small dense, darkly granular megakaryocytic fragment. No leukocytes or nucleated red cells are present in this field to assess for a leukoerythroblastic picture. Giant and bizarre platelets with circulating megakaryocytic fragments and dacrocytes are characteristic of myelofibrosis. Findings are consistent with primary myelofibrosis in the appropriate clinical and marrow biopsy context.

ddx.vs: ET has giant platelets but lacks teardrop poikilocytosis and circulating megakaryocytic fragments, with normal red cell morphology.
Inherited disorders show uniformly large platelets with thrombocytopenia (and Döhle-like inclusions in MYH9) but normal red cells without dacrocytes.
Marrow infiltration produces the same blood picture; marrow biopsy and driver mutation testing distinguish it from PMF.
